mechanism: Torsemide-induced volume depletion and electrolyte abnormalities may increase susceptibility to infections that etanercept (TNF inhibitor) already increases through immunosuppression, and diuretics can reduce renal perfusion affecting etanercept clearance.
action: Monitor renal function, electrolytes, and volume status closely; ensure adequate hydration; consider infection screening given additive immunosuppressive effects; adjust diuretic dosing if needed based on renal function.
